marketing: Heading weight conflicts. The system's type tokens set h1 to h5 at weight 500 (tokens/semantic/type.json), but the brand guidelines (AGD-DESIGN.md:88, every style Regular 400) and the live site (font-normal on hero, section and card headings; prose headings forced to 400 at globals.css:1701) use 400. Recipes reference var(--ds-text-hN-weight) so one token fix updates everything. I trust the site and Figma (400): two sources agree, and the principle says emphasis is color, not weight.

Letter spacing conflicts. The site puts -0.035em on every redesigned headline (home-design.ts:1, hero.tsx:148, closing-cta.tsx:24) and leaves tracking-tight on legacy pieces. The Figma guidelines say 0 and the system's check rejects any tracking (src/check/rules/typography.ts:37). Recipes use letter-spacing: 0. The site needs a cleanup pass, or the brand owner signs off on headline tracking.

The card ring is built differently. The site's brand-glass-ring is a translucent 10% blue wrapper with 8px padding and a -8px margin, and its outer radius equals the card's 8px. Inside sits a white card with a 1px 8% black ring. The system's Card uses an opaque bg-tint wrapper with 4px padding, a 12px rounded-window outside and no hairline. Recipes follow the site's geometry (8px, same radius) with system tokens, because the site is newer and AGD-DESIGN.md describes a 10px ring. The registry card should be updated to match.

Buttons are not unified on the site. The hero and content use the brand pill: 20px by 12px, regular weight, black filled or blue outline. The header's Start for free uses DarkCtaLink instead: a #222 bevel key, 42px tall, text-sm, with its pill radius forced by a header-only override (radius-brand-button is 0.5rem in .brand-system, globals.css:784, even though AGD-DESIGN.md says full pill). There is also buttonVariants.marketing (font-medium, tracking, h-50px), plus legacy filled CTAs with #268bff in pricing and the footer heart. Recipes follow the brand pill and the system Button. Pill hover is #333 on the site and #191919 in the token.

rem values do not match px tokens. Above 43.2rem the site sets the root font to 90% (globals.css:5), so every rem-based value renders at 90%, while the system's spacing tokens are px and its type tokens rem. Recipes translate site rem values assuming a 16px root. Expect them to look about 10% larger than the live desktop site unless the target also scales its root.

The site breaks the brand rules in places, so restyled sites should not copy these: a frosted backdrop blur on the header and dropdown (principles.md says no glass), water and glass textures on hero cards (textured-card.tsx, glass-highlight.tsx), a conic-gradient spinning SOC badge, an uppercase RECOMMENDED badge, a semibold footer, and testimonial names.

The site's motion runs longer than the 300ms UI limit: header morph 500ms, mega menu open 300ms and switch 400ms, mobile menu reveal 320 to 420ms, hero stagger 360ms. Recipes clamp these to --ds-duration-moderate (250ms) or shorter and keep the site's easing family (emphasized or out). Every transition lists its properties, and none animate from scale 0.

Radix portals (tooltips, dialogs, toasts) mount outside .brand-system. On the live site the tooltip therefore paints the app's light blue primary (hsl 213 94% 68%) instead of brand blue. The tooltip recipe uses the system's inverse tooltip (black, white caption) instead.

The footer is black at 90% (#191919) with white 60% links and semibold titles. The system footer is pure black with neutral-30 links and medium titles. The recipe uses neutral-90 to match the live surface and neutral-30 regular text to keep contrast and the weight rule.

Process: the global CLAUDE.md requires loading the emil-design-eng, improve-animations and animate skills for motion work, but none of them are available in this session. Transition values were held to the task's own motion rules instead: exact properties, tokens, under 300ms, no ease-in, hover gated, and reduced motion respected.
product: Value conventions: every :hover state applies only inside @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine). A state key of the form "@media <query> | <selector>" means that selector inside that media query; a key starting with a space targets a descendant. Wash colors use color-mix(in srgb, var(--ds-color-bg-wash) N%, transparent), which is what the bg-wash/N utilities compile to.

Scope: product type and radius values live on .ds-product (body-sm 12.6px, caption 12px, micro 11px, h4 21px at 450, window radius 10px, subtle text #707070). Dark theme comes from data-theme="dark" on html with .ds-product; these tokens re-point: bg-default, bg-subtle, bg-canvas, bg-frame, bg-wash (black to white), bg-scrim (10% to 50%), bg-shine, text-default, text-muted, text-subtle, text-brand (#5182EF), border-*, action-primary*, status-*, chart-alert*, blue-10..40 and neutral-5..90. bg-brand does not re-point (filled brand stays #2563EB).

Trust order: the design-system repo (ds/) for tokens and the deliberate deviations in ASSUMPTIONS 27 to 32 (focus ring added as shadow-ring-hover, dark brand text #5182EF, sentence case, figures in Rethink Sans); context-dashboard at c0ddf7a for every measurement, spacing and motion value; the site export last, because it is a scoped re-port (.dashboard-system) that already drifts.

Site export conflicts: html behind the dashboard is --color-frame #F2F2F2 instead of the canvas #FAFAFA (site/src/styles/dashboard-system.css:116); focus is a 2px solid brand outline offset 2px (site/src/styles/dashboard-system.css:243) instead of the glass ring; dark brand is #3B73ED as in the dashboard. site/design.md describes the legacy production palette (#268BFF primary, HSL roles) and should not be used for these recipes.

Spacing caveat: the dashboard sets a 15px root, so rem utilities render at 0.9375 of nominal. The Tailwind strings reproduce the dashboard exactly under .ds-product; the css blocks use the px space tokens at nominal values (as product.md and the commits describe them, for example "12px on all sides"), about 6% larger than the rendered dashboard. See missing_tokens.

Deliberate dashboard-to-system changes kept: brand outline text and edges use text-brand (blue-80 in dark); primary black button hover is action-primary-hover (#D4D4D8 in dark, the dashboard used neutral-90 #ECECEF); composer focus uses shadow-ring-hover (translucent brand) where the dashboard used a solid blue-10 4px ring; letter-spacing (tracking-tight on figures, tracking-wide on mono labels) is dropped because the check rejects letter-spacing; the tooltip gains a 150ms popover-in on its first show.

Dashboard copy is Title Case in places (stat titles, "API Keys", range labels "Last 7 Days", user menu items); recipes follow voice.md sentence case. One em dash exists in the dashboard time zone list (settings) and must not be copied.

Sidebar current item uses font-medium in both the dashboard and the port, which product.md's "never bold" line does not mention; kept as the one weight change in the product (also the workspace name and credits trigger).

Bug found in the port: ds/registry/ui/app-status/app-status.tsx:8 uses bg-subtle for the neutral halo, but the theme defines surface-subtle, not subtle, so the neutral halo renders with no fill. It should be bg-surface-subtle.

Port differences to watch: app-stat-cards uses text-h4 (21px) for figures where the dashboard uses 22px; app-code-card uses text-caption with leading-relaxed (1.625) where the dashboard uses 12px at 1.65; ds-chart-bar-in starts at scaleY(0.04) instead of 0 (keeps the never-from-zero rule); the dialog scrim uses pt-24 instead of 12vh.
